title: 中山金杯の後に・幸先ええで！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kimpai is a special race that brings good luck, and with Tamamo Cross eager to seize some for herself, it comes at the perfect time for her to enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And victory is hers! As spring blossoms in Nakayama, Tamamo Cross shares her blessings with her fans.
